pages.text: Your progression tracker, guide, and reward system. The quest book is not optional — it is how you advance tiers.

$(bold)Opening:$(/bold) Default key $(bold)P$(/bold) or click the shield icon in the HUD.$(br2)$(bold)Nine chapters:$(/bold) Welcome · $(t1)Tier 1$(end)–$(t4)4$(end) · Crucible · Community · Prestige · Classes & Skills.$(br2)$(bold)Five paths per tier:$(/bold) Grinding, Magic, Combat, Exploration, Engineering. Complete any one to advance.

$(bold)Skill points:$(/bold) Every quest path rewards skill points. Completing all 5 paths in a tier gives approximately 10 extra points beyond the minimum. This is the primary reason to complete non-required paths.$(br2)$(bold)Loot boxes:$(/bold) Non-required path completions reward loot boxes. The Prestige chapter gives endgame rewards.
